definition: to change the place something is in
description: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

taps.phrase: to stretch out on the sofa
